User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /signup
Disallow: /verify
Disallow: /forgot-password
Disallow: /creator/
Disallow: /business/
# Listing pages require sign-in (RequireAuth in AppRoutes.tsx) — crawling
# them just hits a redirect to /login. Their detail pages (/creators/:handle,
# /businesses/:id, /events/:id) stay open and indexable.
Disallow: /creators$
Disallow: /businesses$
Disallow: /events$
